note: Motor weights now come from the motor's own data file rather than the catalogue entry beside it — thrustcurve.org publishes both, they disagree, and taking the thrust curve from one document while taking the weights from the other was never defensible. Desktop OpenRocket reads the file, and so does this now. With that and the file's own simulation time step honoured, this app reproduces a desktop-saved simulation to every digit the file stores, where before it ran 0.84% under.
